text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
--Prime Minister Hariri discussed with Syrian Vice President Khaddam the issue of five Japanese Red Army suspects arrested in Lebanon and the regional peace developments.
--Will French President Chirac and Christian Maronite Patriarch Sfeir meet in Sao Paulo?
--Investigative Judge Mirza interrogates the Japanese suspects. New lawyers volunteer to defend them.
--The Bank of Lebanon is shaping the financial and administrative policies of Lebanon's national air carrier, Middle East Airlines.
--Hizbollah guerrillas wounded one Israeli soldier in a rocket attack inside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
--Two Israeli air raids on south and southeast Lebanon and Israeli artillerymen shell southern areas facing the occupation zone.
--Demand on Solidere A shares doubled last week.
